q: how does paperhint work
reply: It works from the paper you already produce. You photograph answer sheets with the mobile app, and every answer is checked against its question and scored on your rubric — you review and approve the results. Question papers and teaching notes are tailored to your syllabus, ensuring everything aligns with what you need. Plus, attendance is scanned, making it easy to keep track of absences and reach out to parents the same day. All of this runs on a phone and a browser; no new hardware is needed.

q: my class 8B has fallen behind on fractions, what do I do
reply:
First, identify where they struggle with fractions. It might not be fractions themselves but foundational concepts like equivalence. Here's a plan: 

1. Revisit equivalence with a couple of quick exercises. 2. Teach common denominators next; get them to practice finding common denominators for simple fractions. 3. Introduce addition and subtraction of fractions using hands-on examples. 4. Provide a few problems to solve individually, then review as a group. 5. Incorporate a concept per lesson for the next week, including a quick recap of the previous day's topic. That was one plan in a chat. With Paperhint, this approach keeps getting refined for every class on your syllabus, making your teaching more efficient.
